wizard.title: Guided connection
wizard.bt_windows: Bluetooth ELM327 on Windows: plug the adapter into the vehicle, switch ignition on, pair it in Windows under Bluetooth & devices (common PINs are 1234 or 0000), then select the created COM port.
wizard.bt_linux: Bluetooth ELM327 on Linux: plug the adapter into the vehicle, switch ignition on, pair it using the desktop Bluetooth settings or bluetoothctl. The application can then use or create the RFCOMM serial port.
